title: Burger Tycoon: Grill Convoy
shortDescription: Burger truck manager: pick the pitch, pack the truck and beat the lunch rush
fullDescription:
Lunch hour at the Office Plaza. The line wraps around the planter, the grill is spitting, and you have forty patties left. Across town the stadium crowd is waiting for halftime. You run the burger trucks of Cinder Bay. Be in the right place with the right stock.

Grill Convoy is a burger truck manager about flow. Each morning you choose where every truck parks, what it carries and how the kitchen inside is laid out. Then the service starts and the crowd arrives.

PLAN THE MORNING
- Check the city map: the weather forecast, match days, weekends and rival trucks.
- Send each truck to a pitch: the Office Plaza lunch rush, the Boardwalk on hot weekends or the Stadium on match days.
- Pack the truck by the forecast. Pack too little and you sell out; pack too much and the leftovers spoil.
- Keep the commissary kitchen prepping patties, buns and fries for tomorrow.

BUILD THE KITCHEN
- The inside of the truck is a small grid and the layout is the puzzle: grill, assembly bench, window, toaster, sauce rail, fryer, drink fridge and wrap bench.
- Short walks make a fast line. A toaster next to the bench and fries next to the window pay off.
- Hire grillers, assemblers, cashiers and runners, and see the slowest station at a glance.
- Choose the menu board: Classic, Cheese, Double, Spicy, Veggie, Breakfast, Kids and Premium burgers. Fewer cards means a faster line.

BEAT THE RUSH
- Customers queue with patience bars: office workers in a hurry, match fans in groups, beach families and tourists.
- Call All hands on a long line, send a restock run before you sell out and put out grease flare-ups.
- Short, announced events keep every day different: the halftime stampede, rain on the boardwalk, heat waves, an empty propane tank and a rival truck parking next to yours.
- Nothing ends your game. A bad day costs sales and reputation, and the day report shows what to fix.

GROW A CONVOY
- Earn Fame with three-star days and open the Boardwalk and the Stadium.
- 24 research projects: new burgers, hotter grills, a second window, order-ahead pickups, par levels and Head cook rules that pack, cook and restock for you.
- Add a second truck with a bigger kitchen and run two pitches at once.
- While you are away, your crew keeps selling and a welcome-back card shows what they earned.

GOOD TO KNOW
- Single-player. No account and no sign-in. Your careers are saved on your device.
- A step-by-step guide shows each action the first time. Replay it any time from Settings.
- Choose Low, Medium or High graphics to suit your phone.
- The game contains ads and optional in-app purchases: one-time upgrades, looks for your trucks and crew, and cash packs. Nothing is needed to finish the game.
- Ads show our other games in a banner and between days. Remove Ads, the Pitmaster Edition, the Convoy Pass and the Complete Grill Convoy remove them. Other purchases do not remove ads.
- Reward videos are always optional. With ad removal you get the same capped rewards without a video.
- Cash packs are used up and are not restored on a new device.
- Ten languages: English, Turkish, German, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Russian, Japanese, Korean and Hindi.

If you like food truck games, burger restaurant tycoons and street food management, park your first truck and feed the lunch rush.
